events.title: Magellan Killed at the Battle of Mactan
events.description: Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan, leading a Spanish expedition to circle the globe, was killed in a clash with the forces of Mactan Island in the Philippines.
events.significance: Magellan did not live to see the voyage finish. His surviving crew carried on and completed the first circumnavigation of the Earth in 1522.

events.title: Samuel F. B. Morse Is Born
events.description: The future painter and inventor was born in Charlestown, Massachusetts. He grew up to co-develop the electric telegraph and the Morse code system.
events.significance: Morse's telegraph and code changed long-distance communication. Messages that once took days or weeks could now cross continents almost instantly.

events.title: Antonio Gramsci Dies in Rome
events.description: The Italian philosopher and political leader died at age 46, days after a stroke. He had spent years in Fascist prisons, where he wrote his influential notebooks.
events.significance: Gramsci's ideas on cultural hegemony still shape political theory, sociology and cultural studies around the world.

events.title: South Africa Holds Its First Multiracial Election
events.description: Millions of South Africans of all races voted in the country's first fully democratic general election. Many waited in long lines to cast a ballot for the first time.
events.significance: The election ended the apartheid era's system of white-minority rule and brought Nelson Mandela to the presidency.
